findings.source: FlashLoans.sol: recipient.receiveFlashLoan(tokens, amounts, feeAmounts, userData); Authentication: _getAuthorizer().canPerform(actionId, user, address(this)); SafeERC20 safeTransfer/safeTransferFrom
findings.issue: The flash-loan callback, the authorizer check, the SafeERC20 transfers and the pool hooks built in memory after an allocation lose their function and arguments (about 50 unnamed calls); their arguments are assembled by copy loops.
findings.rule: Same root cause as c00409: stores at mload(0x40) + k cannot alias slot 0x40 (pointer >= 0x80, sizes < 2^64), so forward them into the call input; the call then resolves to its selector and ABI words.

findings.issue: 231 storage accesses into the EnumerableMap/EnumerableSet structs of a mapping are printed as raw slot arithmetic (and the pool's token count as stor[_319]), though the decompiler already names stor1[poolId].field_0 and stor8[poolId].field_0 for the same structs.
findings.rule: stor[sha3(k, sha3(key, N) + j) + m] is a mapping-of-mapping/struct access: struct at mapping N[key], member j (a mapping) indexed by k, member m; stor[sha3(sha3(key, N)) + i] is element i of the dynamic array at N[key] (member 0); print them as such.

findings.rule: After w = mem[p], read mem[p + 18 len 14] as uint112(w) and mem[p + 4 len 14] as uint112(w >> 112); a - (a - b) * (a < b) is max(a, b); concat(Bytes(12, 0), mem[p + 12 len 20]) is address(mem[p]).

notes: 26 ABI functions plus the fallback/receive reviewed. Long functions (batchSwap, queryBatchSwap, swap, joinPool, exitPool, manageUserBalance) reviewed by structure; getPoolTokens, getInternalBalance, registerTokens, deregisterTokens read in full. Loops: 24 explicit loops (each counted once): the loops of batchSwap, deregisterTokens, flashLoan (2), getInternalBalance, managePoolBalance, manageUserBalance, registerTokens, _translateToIERC20, totalsAndLastChangeBlock, the 4 register/deregister and 2 get-tokens loops of General/MinimalSwapInfo pools, _setGeneral/_setMinimalSwapInfoPoolBalances, _processJoin/_processExitPoolTransfers, _unsafeCastToInt256, _validateTokensAndGetBalances, _processGeneralPoolSwapRequest, _swapWithPools; all shown as readable whiles (39 inlined copies). The other 68 whiles are implicit: 13 validating calldata decodes (readable) and 55 memory copies (P7). P11: the 77 'assert s < length' bounds checks inside loops whose test is s < the same length. P4 header count kept (2); the 68 two-part concat keys are a separate shape (finding 4). No semantic error found (checked _getPoolSpecialization's 'value < 3' BAL#500 check, totalsAndLastChangeBlock, the two-token toBalance overflow BAL#526, the register/deregister flows).
summary: All 24 loops are present and readable and the logic is faithful, but EnumerableMap/Set storage is raw slot arithmetic, 55 copies stay loops, and the flash-loan callback, authorizer and token-transfer calls lose their names after an allocation.
